0|e15f8c01af924e611bc7be1e45449c4a74e5dfdd|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"mlock: fix race when munlocking pages in do_wp_page()
vmscan can lazily find pages that are mapped within VM_LOCKED vmas
set the PageMlocked bit on these pages
unevictable list.  When do_wp_page() breaks COW within a VM_LOCKED vma
it may need to clear PageMlocked on the old page and set it on the new
page instead.
This change fixes an issue where do_wp_page() was clearing PageMlocked
on the old page while the pte was still pointing to it (as well as
rmap).  Therefore
column2: we were not protected against vmscan immediately

column1: transfering the old page back onto the unevictable list.  This could
cause pages to get stranded there forever.
I propose to move the corresponding code to the end of do_wp_page()
after the pte (and rmap) have been pointed to the new page.
Additionally
column2: we can use munlock_vma_page() instead of

column1: clear_page_mlock()
column2: so that the old page stays mlocked if there are

column1: still other VM_LOCKED vmas mapping it.
